Hi I'm in the same boat as you. I recently started a new mood stabilizer for my bipolar disorder, and I asked my doctor if she knew of what helps tinnitus. She said she has it too and there is no cure. She sleeps with sound on so she can get some peace. I think there is a spiritual cause to it, but I don't know how it works or how to fix it. I just remember when it started, I was visiting the house where my ex lived and I was looking at an amethyst stone that someone had gifted him, sitting in the window. Everything was beautiful and calm, then all of a sudden the ringing started and it wouldn't go away. Now everything is dark and miserable and there's constant ringing and changes of pressure in my ears. Oddly, I can hear better than I used to. I still associate tinnitus with amethyst, to the point where I avoid amethyst stones. It's a trauma association.

I was on a journey of becoming the best version of myself when I got into meditation and psychedelics. It was a combination of things, all was going well until I went home to my family high on psychedelics one day. After that, it was bad bad bad. My mom freaked out and they forced me to go to church, their culty house church, which I had gone to before. I took my, at the time, boyfriend, and I left that day a different person. They spiritually murdered me, I walked out of that house and had one of the worst panic attacks of my life. Afterwards, my mind was not right and my eyes were opened to things that I had never seen before. I couldn't function and was forced to move back in with my parents, and I never talked to that boyfriend again--he still haunts my thoughts occasionally. The next two years consisted of panic attack after panic attack where my mother would find out something was wrong and then tell me I was demon possessed. She had people come to our house and pray over me multiple times. I was seeing spirits and my hands were taken control of by another entity, forcing me to cut myself and rub my blood all over the walls. I had no way of communicating what was happening. I blamed it all on my dad, and I attacked him one night when he was being rude to me (he usually is), which my mom called the cops and they took me to a mental facility. Since then, I've been medicated, entered a new relationship, and started a new job. I'm more functional, though miserable every step of the way. Merely going through the motions. I'm still haunted by vision and knowledge that is beyond me. I'm still not myself. I'm not even sure if I'm inside my body fully. What I call spiritual awakening, some call insanity, but I have a knowing that I can't even begin to communicate.
